issue_request: FHIR-5783 asked for logical references to value sets in binding/reference locations and terminology operations to be able to identify a specific ValueSet.version, with versionless references resolving to the latest known value set when multiple versions match.
initial_application: Historical git-svn commit 06210c87a1 / svn r4668 applied the issue by adding source/terminologies.html guidance for version-specific logical value set references and the latest-version fallback.
additional_context: FHIR-10576 later changed the version-specific syntax from ?version to canonical url|version and generalized it to conformance resources; FHIR-16055 changed ElementDefinition.binding.valueSet[x] to canonical(ValueSet); FHIR-18673 clarified canonical URL/reference terminology. No directly relevant conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current source/terminologies.html lists the relevant value-set reference locations and states the url|version rule and latest-version fallback, while ElementDefinition, ValueSet, OperationDefinition, Questionnaire, and ConceptMap source definitions use canonical(ValueSet) or otherwise allow version-specific value set references.
